description: Source code for a Python implementation of a CSON (schema-compressed JSON) parser and converter, including functions for tokenizing, converting to JSON, resolving references, and command-line interface.

methods.name: isName
methods.description: Checks if a character is a valid name character in CSON syntax.

methods.name: isWS
methods.description: Checks if a character is whitespace.

methods.name: isCRLF
methods.description: Checks if a character sequence represents a carriage return and line feed.

methods.name: isNameSeparator
methods.description: Checks if a character is a name separator (':' or '=').

methods.name: isEndOfDQuote
methods.description: Checks if a character marks the end of a double-quoted string.

methods.name: isEndOfSQuote
methods.description: Checks if a character marks the end of a single-quoted string.

methods.name: isBeginOfBracket
methods.description: Checks if a character is an opening bracket '{' or '['.

methods.name: isEndOfBracket
methods.description: Checks if a character is a closing bracket '}' or ']'.

methods.name: stringToLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string to a JSON-compatible literal with escape sequences.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a string represents a JSON number.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if a string is 'true' or 'false'.

methods.name: isRef
methods.description: Checks if a string is a reference starting with '@'.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if a string is 'null'.

methods.name: get_iterable
methods.description: Returns an iterable over list, dict keys, or string length.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes CSON text into a list of tokens.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Converts tokenized CSON text into formatted JSON string.

methods.name: csons2json
methods.description: Converts CSON string to JSON string with optional indentation.

methods.name: getrefvalue
methods.description: Dereferences a reference path in a data object.

methods.name: setrefvalue
methods.description: Sets a value at a reference path in a data object.

methods.name: findrefs
methods.description: Finds all references in a nested dictionary.

methods.name: resolveRefs
methods.description: Resolves all references in a list, replacing reference strings with actual data.

methods.name: csons2py
methods.description: Converts CSON string to Python data structure, resolving references.

methods.name: cson2py
methods.description: Reads a file and converts its CSON content to Python data structure.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Command-line interface for the CSON Python implementation.
